title: From ‘storming’ to ‘performing’ in eight [[~months.]]
summary: A new, fast-growing team with a lot of responsibility needed to define its role, its culture and what success would look like. Eight months later it was consistently performing, and an essential part of the wider business.
brief:
We supported the cultural development of multiple Sony Music teams through workshops and coaching.

One team came to us at a difficult time. In the words of its director: “We were a new team in the business, were growing quickly and had a lot of responsibility. We needed to understand our role as a team and help define our team culture and what our future success would look like.”
did: Understand the whole system
Time taken to fully understand the business, the team, its needs, challenges and strengths, and the many, sometimes competing, dynamics.
Executive + group coaching
A blend of executive and group coaching, delivered over several sessions.
Facilitation that feels safe
Facilitation tools that established a safe and open environment for the team to express themselves.
A path to success
The tools to address the team’s challenges and set a path to success.
impact:
The team progressed from ‘storming’ to consistently ‘performing’ in just eight months, while building a positive, thriving and compassionate team environment.

Its overall sentiment about the team culture went from 75% negative mentions to less than 10%, and it developed into a high-performing team and an essential part of the wider business.
quotes: Vanessa came in to help us when we were at a really difficult time as a team… We worked with Vanessa over several sessions and the care that was given to us as a team gave us all the confidence to understand the things we were doing well and the areas that needed improvement. Vanessa’s unique, colourful style and approach gave us the tools to address our challenges and set a path to success, whilst establishing a safe and open environment for the team to express themselves.

title: One keynote. A standing ovation. Two years of [[~summits.]]
summary: An invitation to speak to 120 senior women at Levi’s HQ in Belgium became a workshop series, and two years as emcee of the company’s gender equity summit.
metrics: as emcee of the gender equity summit
brief:
Vanessa was invited to speak at Levi’s HQ in Belgium, delivering a keynote on career progression, networking and growth mindset to 120 senior women.

The audience left so inspired that the conversation needed somewhere to go next.
did: A keynote that landed
Career progression, networking and growth mindset, delivered with energy, storytelling and insight. It earned a standing ovation and a host of compliments.
Follow-up workshops
A series of three-hour workshops to act on the insights: a safe space for senior women to overcome limiting beliefs and define a plan of action.
Emcee of the gender equity summit
Invited back two years in a row to host the summit, shaping conversations and enabling boldness, connection and progress.
impact: What started as one keynote became a multi-year relationship, with Vanessa trusted to hold the room for one of the company’s most important conversations about gender equity.
quotes: What an honour to have been in that room with you. It was an incredible moment. Such energy, such emotion, such joy. You made a profound impact on me and others. What a memory!
It was a great moment for all! I also remember you in the small room in 2018 talking to a group of women and sharing your inspirations! I started to think bigger after meeting you!

That day you helped us realise that we’re not alone. Connecting hearts and minds is the biggest strength women have… Thank you again Vanessa for your great contribution to my and other 120 women’s life.

title: A ‘guiding light’ for a community where everyone [[~belongs.]]
summary: Introduced by the founder as the right partner for Gymshark’s inclusive high performance journey, we spent two years helping shape a culture of belonging.
metrics: introduced us as the right partner
brief:
Gymshark’s mission was to foster an employee community where everyone truly feels they belong.

Introduced by the founder as the right partner to guide that inclusive high performing culture journey, we worked closely with leadership, a group of dedicated employees and the HR team.
did: Inclusive high performance training
Training to support the business’s inclusive high performing culture journey.
HR consultancy
Consultancy to the HR team on the review of their employee life cycle.
Cultural events
Hosting cultural events for the employee community.
Brand campaigns
Supporting the brand team with some of their campaigns.
impact: Over two years, the partnership helped Gymshark make sure its values were conveyed the right way and that it truly showed up for its people, with our role described by the Chief Brand Officer as a ‘guiding light’.
quotes: Vanessa was a guiding light when we needed her most. In these times, even when intentions are good it is only too easy to be misunderstood or misstep. Thankfully, we had Vanessa to ensure that our business’ values were conveyed in the right way, at the right time and we truly showed up for our people the way we wanted to. Starting as a consultant, and quickly becoming a friend: one of life’s good people.

title: An L&D programme that keeps getting [[~renewed.]]
summary: Since 2021, a leading global beauty and luxury group has trusted us to design and lead its inclusive high performance learning programme, now three years and counting.
brief: A leading global beauty and luxury group partnered with us in 2021 to design and lead its L&D inclusive high performance programme, developing inclusive leadership and high-performance skills across the business.
did: Designed and led the programme
Effective feedback, growth mindset, emotional intelligence and cultural intelligence.
Expanded in 2024
Four new workshops for managers and employees across head office and retail.
Skills plus group coaching
Skill development blended with group coaching so learning turns into practice.
Leadership in the room
Senior leaders take part, fostering a learning culture from the top.
impact:
More than 45 workshops delivered, with 400+ employees engaged each year. Participants rate it 5/5 for usefulness, 4/5 for confidence in inclusive leadership and 5/5 for trainer expertise.

The programme continues to drive lasting cultural and business impact, proving that an inclusive workforce is a high-performing workforce.
